classification.difficultyReason: Represent the length as twice the width, combine like terms in the perimeter equation and calculate both dimensions.

inlines.text: A rectangular garden bed is twice as long as it is wide.
Calculate the length and width if the perimeter is 72 cm.

spec.answerVisibility: Only stated dimensions or unknowns; no derived answers.

answer.worked:
Let $w$ be the width in centimetres. The length is $2w$ centimetres.

$$\begin{align*}P&=2l+2w\\72&=2(2w)+2w\\72&=6w\\w&=12\\l&=2(12)\\l&=24\end{align*}$$

The length is $24\text{ cm}$ and the width is $12\text{ cm}$.
